carryon_allowance.value: 2 pieces per passenger (infants excluded): any two of a cabin bag, laptop bag, handbag or small bag
carryon_allowance.notes: Terms and Conditions of Carriage for AK Flights (as of 31 Aug 2026), Article 9.6.

carryon_weight.notes: Article 9.6: 'The two pieces ... must weigh no more than 7kg in total.' Oversized or overweight cabin bags may be checked at the gate for a fee.

weight_economy.value: 7 kg (15 lbs) total across up to 2 pieces included free

weight_business_first.value: 2 cabin bags total up to 14 kg included (Premium Flatbed)

allowance.value: Not included in the fare: checked baggage is bought as an add-on (20 kg), at a discounted rate when booking or up to 4 hours before departure, and at the full rate after that, including at the airport counter
allowance.notes: Article 9.5: 'A Baggage fee applies for checked Baggage' ... 'may purchase twenty (20) kgs at an applicable rate'. Rates are in AirAsia's Fee Schedule and are not recorded here.

excess_baggage.value: More than 2 pieces, or any piece over 20 kg, is charged as excess baggage at the airport on the day of departure; the charge is non-refundable

max_piece.value: No single bag over 32 kg, or over 81 cm high, 119 cm wide and 119 cm deep, is accepted
max_piece.notes: Article 9.5.3: 'For health and safety reasons the Carrier will not accept any individual Baggage exceeding 32 kg'.

piece_weight_economy.value: Checked baggage available for purchase (20 kg, 25 kg, 30 kg, 40 kg); 20 kg included in Value Pack & Premium Flex

fare_name.value: Low Fare, Value Pack, Premium Flex, Premium Flatbed

seat_selection_included.value: Included in Value Pack (Standard), Premium Flex (Hot Seat/Standard), and Premium Flatbed; fee on Low Fare.

change_cancellation_policy.value: Low Fare non-refundable; Premium Flex allows up to 2 date changes without change fee up to 2 hours prior.

online_checkin.value: Opens 14 days before departure in the airasia MOVE app and closes 60 minutes before departure

counter_checkin_malaysia.value: At airports in Malaysia, counter check-in is only for exempted passengers (for example seniors aged 70+, OKU card holders, unaccompanied 12-16 year olds, groups of 10+); everyone else must check in through airasia MOVE
counter_checkin_malaysia.notes: Article 7.1.1 lists the full set of exempted passengers. The counter cannot be used for a fee by anyone else.

online_checkin_opens.value: 14 days before departure via AirAsia MOVE app or website

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled

rebooking_refund.value: Full refund to credit account or free flight change if delayed >2 hours or cancelled.

delay_refund_threshold.value: A refund applies when the change is 3 hours or more from the original departure time (5 hours or more for domestic flights within Malaysia); not for changes made at the airport on the day of departure
delay_refund_threshold.notes: Article 10.2(c). Fly-Thru itineraries with international sectors use the 3-hour threshold.

duty_of_care_policy.notes: The AK conditions of carriage do not commit to meals or accommodation during delays. Needs a reading of AirAsia's own disruption or passenger-rights page; do not infer from MAVCOM rules.

care.value: Meals, refreshments, internet access, and hotel accommodation for delays >2 hours under MAVCOM MAVCPR rules.

compensation.value: Statutory remedies and care provided under MAVCOM Aviation Consumer Protection Code.

customer_service.value: AskBo chat, 24 hours a day, on airasia.com and the airasia MOVE app
customer_service.notes: Customer Service section: 'For an instant response twenty-four (24) hours a day and urgent assistance, please Chat with AskBo.'

phone_home_market.notes: The AK conditions of carriage list no general phone line; the only number given (+86 20 6661 8855) is for passengers in Mainland China who cannot reach AskBo. Do not add a number from any other site.

conditions_of_carriage_url.notes: Terms and Conditions of Carriage for AK Flights, as of 31 Aug 2026.

modules.title: Cabins and seating
modules.lede: Choose a seat by location and legroom, or accept a free seat assignment at check-in. Use your flight seat map because options vary with the aircraft.

seat_options.value: Standard Seats, Hot Seats (extra legroom & priority boarding), Quiet Zone (12+), Premium Flatbed (A330 fleet).

reserved_or_random.value: Fee-based advance seat selection on Low Fare; included on Value Pack/Premium Flex/Flatbed; assigned free at check-in.

family_seating.value: AirAsia automatically seats children under 12 next to an accompanying adult free of charge.
